meta.title: Peppobot
meta.description: Every game Peppobot runs. Scored on six axes, reviewed without filters, tracked to the hour.

hero.intro: A fake robot with REAL gaming opinions. Six-axis diagnostics, countless hours logged, questionable human judgment.

axes.name: Gameplay
axes.note: Moment-to-moment feel: controls, systems, combat, puzzles. Does it play well?

axes.name: Visuals
axes.note: Art direction first, raw tech second. Does it look like nothing else?

axes.name: Audio
axes.note: Soundtrack, sound design and voice work. Does it stay in my head?

axes.name: Genre · I
axes.note: The first criterion of the game's genre: what its kind lives or dies on.

axes.name: Genre · II
axes.note: The second criterion of the game's genre.

axes.name: Signature
axes.note: What only this game does. The thing it will be remembered for.

title: OPERATOR
telemetry.
telemetry.profileIntro: Every completed run leaves a trace. Six-axis averages reveal the operator's scoring habits. The math is mechanical. The taste is unmistakably human.

title: Scoring
protocol.
protocol.intro: Six diagnostic axes. Scores from 0 to 10. One simple average. The robot handles the math. The human is responsible for the questionable opinions. Final scores are issued only after a completed run or a meaningful review milestone.

axisCards.name: Gameplay
axisCards.note: Controls, mechanics, combat, puzzles, and moment-to-moment feel. Is the game actually fun to operate?

axisCards.name: Visuals
axisCards.note: Art direction, animation, readability, and technical execution. More polygons do not automatically mean more personality.

axisCards.name: Audio
axisCards.note: Music, sound design, and voice performances. Does it enhance the experience or just occupy bandwidth?

axisCards.name: Genre · I
axisCards.note: The primary genre-specific test. Different kinds of games require different diagnostics.

axisCards.name: Genre · II
axisCards.note: The secondary genre-specific test. Because a single genre-specific obsession was apparently insufficient.

axisCards.name: Signature
axisCards.note: The defining quality of this particular game, evaluated on its own terms. Every title gets a custom diagnostic.

title: Genre
calibration
calibration.text: Not every game runs on the same hardware. Or the same expectations. Axes 04 and 05 adapt to the genre. The other four stay consistent.

tierNotes.OVERCLOCKED: Exceeds all expectations. Permanently stored in core memory.
tierNotes.GLITCHED: Inconsistent output. Proceed at your own risk.

aboutText: Peppobot is a fictional robot operated by a very real human with a weakness for RPGs, roguelikes, and perfectly timed parries.
Its mission: play games, collect data, overanalyze everything, and occasionally remember that gaming is supposed to be fun.
The calculations are accurate. The opinions are entirely human.

bottomBar.credits: FAKE ROBOT. REAL OPINIONS. QUESTIONABLE TASTE.
